name: Hyundai Motor Group
sub: IONIQ 5s for Motional and Waymo, 50,000 committed
regions: Global; US robotaxi programs; Singapore manufacturing
leadership: Euisun Chung, Executive Chair; Minwoo Park, President, head of the Advanced Vehicle Platform division and CEO of 42dot since February 2026
about: Automotive group behind Hyundai, Kia, Genesis, Motional ownership, IONIQ 5 robotaxi variants, and the Waymo IONIQ 5 platform partnership.
model: Vehicle manufacturing, mobility services, strategic AV ventures, and factory-integrated autonomous platforms.
deployment: IONIQ 5 used by Motional and selected by Waymo for future robotaxi integration; Avride also uses retrofitted IONIQ 5s.
metrics: Waymo-Hyundai partnership announced in 2024; testing expected from late 2025.
signal: Hyundai is one of the most important non-Chinese OEM platform suppliers for scaled robotaxi fleets.

sources.title: Hyundai Motor Group Appoints Dr. Minwoo Park as Head of Advanced Vehicle Platform Division and CEO of 42dot
